r/malelivingspace on Reddit: Anyone got a good review on Coaster furniture? Thinking about buying this couch.
s: February 10, 2015 - Coaster is an importer, they do not manufacture furniture themselves. They have factories across Asia produce it for them, they then import to the US. This is common for a lot of different furniture companies. They work with so many factories, that you can't really base the consistency off of their furniture based on one piece you have. They are fine quality, no better and no worse than most. I would buy it from a retailer that will back up what they are selling, that is more important.
